description: Google Countries. Search Google countries and retrieve country codes (free Finder endpoint).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: Filter countries by a search string (case-insensitive). Returns all countries whose code or name matches the specified query.
